Editor

Configure how Porpita persists file edits.

Format on Save

Format text before manual saves and auto save. Configure a formatter command in Settings > Projects. Off by default.

Insert Final Newline

Add a line break when saving a non-empty code file that does not end with one. Off by default.

Auto Save Files

Save editor and editable diff changes automatically after a short pause.

Auto Save Delay

How long Porpita waits after your last edit before saving automatically. First launch defaults to 1000 ms.
